notes: Monroe County Republican county committee members were last elected at the June 24, 2025 primary (the 2024 and 2026 primary certifications show county committee contests only for the Democratic Party). No complete list of 2025 Republican county committee filers could be found: the BOE certification of candidates and the canvass list only the two contested EDs (Penfield ED 7 and Wheatland ED 4, each "Vote for 4"), and the archived designating-petition report covers only state committee and judicial delegates. The original PE25 files on monroecounty.gov now return Page Not Found. Because uncontested filers never appear on the ballot, filled/empty status cannot be determined for any ED, so every seat is unknown. ED list (659 EDs) is from the Nov. 4, 2025 Sheriff canvass, which covers every ED in the county; City of Rochester EDs are numbered by county legislative district (LD-ED) as the BOE prints them. Seats: 4 for Penfield ED 7 and Wheatland ED 4 (the "Vote for 4" printed in the 2025 certification); the county Republican committee rules were not found, so every other ED is shown at the statutory minimum of 2 seats. The actual number per ED may be higher; it is not verified.
